title: Three-Scene Story · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Three-Scene Story · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on three everyday settings, such as a room, a park and a shop. The lead tells a short story that visits the settings in the agreed order. The story visits all three settings in order and has an ending. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Three-Scene Story, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The story visits all three settings in order and has an ending.
recall.why: The story visits all three settings in order and has an ending.
